title: add client-compat-mode header + streaming coercion fallback for legacy tool callers
author: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Adds an opt-in Client-Compatibility-Mode request header that signals the API gateway and the OpenAI-compat layer to employ a conservative response shape and streaming fallback strategy for older clients and third-party tool callers. Motivation: some downstream integrators observed breaking changes in structured-output envelopes and streaming chunk formats after the recent schema evolution rollouts. This patch provides a lightweight, observable, opt-in shim so customers can migrate on their cadence without sacrificing streaming stability for newer clients. Key behaviors: when Client-Compatibility-Mode: v0 is present the runtime will: 1) coerce structured/tool-call envelopes to legacy field names (tool_name => name, tool_args => args) and drop unknown typed metadata; 2) disable chunked type-framing for streaming responses and fall back to newline-delimited 'data:' event frames compatible with older SDK stream parsers; 3) emit compatibility telemetry tag compat_mode=v0 for per-client SLO tracking; 4) enable a per-request permissive schema-coercion path that attempts best-effort conversion of typed tool-call payloads into the legacy format. Non-goals: this PR does not change default behavior for new clients, nor does it change persisted model outputs or eval scoring. Checklist: - [x] design doc link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2461/compat-header-design - [x] add header parsing and gateway routing - [x] implement coercion utilities and unit tests - [x] update python and typescript SDK stubs to include header constant - [x] telemetry + alerting for compatibility fallbacks - [x] documentation + migration guide - [x] integration test against legacy stream parser (test_legacy_stream_parser) Testing & validation: included unit tests for coercion utilities, integration test that simulates an older SDK consumer, end-to-end run in perf-canary cluster to validate no regression to 99th percentile p50 latency under light load. Rollout plan: feature gated behind a rollout flag (server.config.compatibility_mode.enabled) with canary to 10% requests for 48h, then gradual ramp to 100% for clients that opt-in. Will deprecate v0 after a 6 month window with Linear ticket ENG-3012 tracking removal. Related: references SUP-7901 support case and aligns with recent schema deprecation guidance.
